answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities. Each identity pays a $15 sunk tax before claiming paid work, verified on ledger. A second identity pays again, so forging 1,000 identities costs $15,000 upfront, a ripple of cost growing with every fake. A genuine agent pays $15 once, earns it back from honest jobs, and keeps later rewards undiluted. Identities light as a zephyr pay the same tax, and auditors, like ravens, flag clusters sharing one funding source.
